BEIT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown

on Map No. 7-L in an area bound by:

West Diversey Avenue; North Lamon Avenue; the alley next South of and parallel to West Diversey

Avenue; and a line 100.00 feet West of and parallel to North Lamon Avenue.

To those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property 4903 W Diversey Ave.
